findings.played: attack GD01-035 Zaku II (rested, no Blocker) with ST01-001 Gundam [attack(59,19)]
findings.better: attack the player with GD01-004 Guncannon and ST01-002 Gundam (MA Form) first (2 shields -> 0), then the player with ST01-001 Gundam for the win; if a Burst stops the lethal, use the Gundam on the Zaku instead
findings.reason: Opponent had 2 shields, no base, no Blocker (Zaku rested and has no Blocker), 0 cards in hand, so 3 attacks at the player win unless a Burst interferes. Attacking the Zaku first with the Gundam threw the win away. Breaking the shields with the other two units and keeping the Gundam to decide covers the same fallback in nearly every Burst case. Only arguable because the line played (kill the opponent's only unit against an empty hand, leave the last shield unbroken so it gives no Burst card) is also very safe.

items.notes: #93 (end_main with MA Form still active against the last shield) not reported: the opponent had no units and no hand, so leaving the shield up keeps it from getting a Burst card that, with its draw, could make a Link Unit to kill P1 (0 shields, no base). #90 Intercept Orders resting the Zaku is part of the plan to kill the Zaku. #94 trigger order (two Repairs) has no effect.
P0 was dead this turn whatever it did: Become a Shield deals 1 damage and no attacker had 1 HP, and the Mikazuki Bursts only add pilots to hand. None of its choices could matter.

P1 correctly went for the exact lethal (4 attackers against 3 shields, no blockers, opponent at 0 active resources with 0 cards). A shield Burst (AP-3) left the last attacker at AP0, and AP0 deals no damage (rule 5-5-5). Deploying the Zaku II afterwards and passing is fine.

#57 Unforeseen Incident on the Zaku III that had not yet attacked does not stop a shield loss (any damage breaks a shield). It does make an attack on P0's rested, damaged Blocker Shiden (HP2) a losing one, which protects P0's only Blocker. That is defensible, so not reported. #58: the target is correct (the attacking Zaku's AP does not matter).

P0 found the only lethal line: Barbatos 4th Form's Deploy effect gives the AP0 Mobile Worker AP1, then two attacks against 1 shield. A shield Burst rested the second attacker. Attacking in the other order would have been just as exposed.

#26/#27: good use of Unforeseen Incident on the attacking Zaku II to win the Guncannon fight, paid with normal resources so the EX resource is kept. #31: P1 passed instead of playing its second Unforeseen Incident on Zee Zulu, which would also have won the fight outright. Holding the second copy for a bigger attacker is reasonable, so not reported.

No clear mistakes. Minor inefficiencies not reported. The Isaribi AP+2 (#35/#36) on Barbatos Adapt was redundant once Mikazuki's +2 came, since the target was only an EX Base (HP3), but it cost nothing. #39 dealt Mikazuki's 1 damage to Gundam NT-1, which has Repair 2, instead of a Guntank without Repair. Debatable, small.

#31/#32: Unforeseen Incident on the attacking Char's Zaku II saved Barbatos 2nd Form (good). #44/#45: Become a Shield killed the HP1 Zaku III (best target). The passes are correct: nothing in hand could stop the base or shield hits.

P1 went for the 2-attack lethal against 1 shield, attacking first with the lower-HP Barbatos Adapt, which is the sensible order against HP-limited Bursts. A Burst rested Barbatos 4th Form. Nothing better was available.

findings.played: play ST03-012 Indignation (AP+2) on GD01-031 Gelgoog while it attacks the player [play_command(54,0)]
findings.better: pass and keep Indignation, for a later battle or to pair as the Neo Zeon pilot Angelo Sauper
findings.reason: Gelgoog was attacking a player who had shields and no base. Any damage breaks a shield, so +2 AP changes nothing. The opponent had 0 active resources, so there was nothing to play around, and Gelgoog cannot battle again this turn. A card and a resource were spent for no effect.

items.notes: No lethal was possible: at most 4 attackers (Geara Zulu linked) against 4 shields. Minor sequencing slip not reported: #56 paid for Zaku II before pairing Full Frontal, whose When Paired effect could have deployed it for free. The saved resource had no use, so it cost nothing. #48 Zeon Remnant Forces putting lasting damage on the Gundam (no Repair) is small but real value.

findings.played: play ST01-014 Unforeseen Incident (AP-3 this turn) on the rested enemy GD03-066 Barbatos 5th Form during Guntank's attack on the player
findings.reason: The target is a rested enemy unit with no Blocker, and the AP-3 lasts only for P0's turn. It changes nothing: Barbatos 5th at AP3 still kills either remaining P0 attacker (both HP3) in a fight, and P0 was going for the player anyway. If the last shield's Burst had stopped the lethal, the card would have been useful in P1's turn.

findings.played: play GD01-099 Intercept Orders resting Barbatos 2nd Form during GD01-001 Gundam's attack on a player with 0 shields and no base
findings.reason: The block step had already passed, and Barbatos 2nd Form has no Blocker anyway, so resting it does nothing to the winning attack. It only uses a card and gives the opponent another action window. Arguable because the game was effectively won, so it had no effect on the outcome.

items.notes: The lethal itself was played correctly (attacks at the player against 2 shields with no enemy blockers).

findings.played: attack the rested GD01-059 Zee Zulu with GD03-001 Gundam NT-1 [0] [attack(0,68)]
findings.better: deploy Davao, attack the player with MA Form, NT-1 [33] and Guncannon [38] (3 shields -> 0), then the player with NT-1 [0] for the win, or use NT-1 [0] on Zee Zulu only if a Burst stopped the lethal
findings.reason: Opponent had 3 shields, no base, no Blocker (Rick Dom has only Breach; Zee Zulu rested), 0 cards in hand: 4 attacks at the player win barring Bursts. Using one of the 4 attackers on Zee Zulu first made lethal impossible. P0 still broke all 3 shields afterwards, so it took the same Burst exposure without the win. The shields-first order keeps the Zee Zulu kill as a fallback (and Davao protects P0 either way), so it dominates the line played.

findings.played: Davao recover 2 HP on GD03-001 Gundam NT-1 [33] at HP5/5 (full)
findings.better: ST01-002 Gundam (MA Form) [2] at HP1/4 (no Repair) -> 3/4
findings.reason: Healing a full-HP unit does nothing, and the activation cost 2 resources. MA Form was the only damaged unit without Repair; NT-1 [0] (HP2/4) gets 2 HP back from Repair 2 at end of turn anyway.

items.notes: In hindsight the third shield was a Zanzibar Burst (base), which would have stopped the 4-attack lethal. But the decider could not know that, and the shields-first order would then have reached the same position as the line played.
